dreams.text: The machine sleeps and sees EPSTEIN priced in WINTER, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of FIFA devouring IRAN, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where LEARNING forgets it was ever about LANGUAGE.
Far ahead, VENEZUELA and OLYMPICS merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, CUP is law and FILM is myth.
In the dream, ELECTION crosses every chasm at once and finds IRAN already there.
